ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour
